appliance.title: Appliance
appliance.description: Sobry picks the cheapest slots of the day and switches the chosen entity on and off.

data_description.name: Names the device and its entities, for example “Water heater”.
data_description.target_entity: Leave empty to only get a binary sensor, to use in your own automations.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Daily window the slots are picked in, and how long to run.

data.require_complete_data: Wait for the whole window to be priced

data_description.hours: Hours to schedule in the window each day. Used as the default when the runtime also comes from a month or an entity.
data_description.threshold_price: Every slot at or under this price is selected. It can also be tuned from its number entity.
data_description.window_start: Same start and end means a full day.
data_description.window_end: An end before the start makes an overnight window.
data_description.max_price: Optional. A slot above it is never selected, even if hours are missing.
data_description.require_complete_data: Keeps the appliance off until every price of the window is published, so the cheapest slots are not missed.
data_description.features: Tick the options to set up at the next step. Unticking one turns it off.

features.title: Options
features.description: Settings of the options ticked at the previous step.

monthly_runtime.name: Runtime per month
monthly_runtime.description: Longer in winter, shorter in summer. A month left empty uses the runtime of the previous step; 0 keeps the appliance off that month.

data_description.hours_entity: An input_number, number or sensor holding a number of hours, for example a template on the outdoor temperature. It wins over the months and the runtime, which take over while it is unavailable.

data.extra_hours: Extra runtime after the last slot

data_description.extra_hours: Keeps the appliance running that long after the last selected slot, whatever the price: a water heater with no temperature reading finishes heating.

power_hold.name: Finish the cycle
power_hold.description: After the last planned window of the day, the appliance keeps running while it still draws power.

data.power_threshold: Power above which the appliance keeps running

data_description.power_entity: A power sensor of the appliance, in W or kW.
data_description.power_threshold: The reading has to stay under it for two minutes before the appliance stops, so a single dip never cuts a heating cycle short.
data_description.power_hold_max: Never extends longer than this after the last planned window, whatever the reading.

always_run.name: Always run below a price
always_run.description: On top of the plan, the appliance runs in every slot at or under this price, whatever the mode, window or runtime.

data.force_skip_negative: Not on days with a negative price

data_description.force_price: 0 catches every free or negative price.
data_description.force_skip_negative: On a day with at least one negative price, only the slots of the plan run.

fallback_schedule.name: Fallback schedule
fallback_schedule.description: Fixed hours used whenever the plan cannot decide: Sobry unreachable, prices not published, or a window it could not fill.

data_description.fallback_end: An end before the start makes an overnight window.

error.name_taken: Another appliance already has this name.
error.fallback_same_times: The fallback start and end must differ.

options.public_c5: Public prices, contract up to 36 kVA (C5)
options.api_key: My Sobry prices, with an API key

options.cheapest_slots: Cheapest slots of the window, consecutive or not
options.threshold: Every slot below a price threshold

options.extra_runtime: Fixed extension after the last slot
options.power_hold: Keep running while the appliance draws power
options.fallback_schedule: Fixed schedule when prices are missing

get_cheapest_slots.name: Get the cheapest slots
get_cheapest_slots.description: Returns the cheapest price slots of a daily window, without creating an appliance.

config_entry_id.name: Sobry entry
config_entry_id.description: Sobry configuration entry to read the prices from.

mode.name: Selection mode
mode.description: How the slots are picked inside the window.

extra_hours.name: Extra runtime
extra_hours.description: Hours to keep running after the last selected slot.

window_start.name: Window start
window_start.description: Start of the daily window. Keep the same start and end for a full day.

window_end.name: Window end
window_end.description: End of the daily window. A window ending before it starts runs overnight.

max_price.name: Maximum price
max_price.description: Never select a slot above this price.

threshold_price.name: Price threshold
threshold_price.description: Price under which slots are selected, for the threshold mode.

force_price.name: Always run below
force_price.description: Also select every slot priced at or below this value, whatever the window, the runtime or the maximum price.

force_skip_negative.name: Not on days with a negative price
force_skip_negative.description: Leave the "always run below" price out on any day that has a negative price.

require_complete_data.name: Require complete prices
require_complete_data.description: Return nothing until every price of the window is published.

entry_not_loaded.message: No loaded Sobry configuration entry was found.

no_prices.message: No Sobry price is available yet.
